name: Inbound lead routing
description: Sort inbound form fills by ICP fit, buyer role and intent before a person touches them. Company size is left out on purpose: Jev is weak with numbers, so do size bands in your CRM or spreadsheet and combine them with these answers. Edit the icp_fit criteria to match your ICP.

icp_fit.instructions: Is this company in a market we sell to, based on company and industry?

criteria.not_a_fit: Consumer, school, student, agency or consultancy, or a competitor
criteria.adjacent: A business, but outside our core industries; worth a light touch
criteria.core: A business in one of our core industries: B2B software, logistics, healthcare technology, or manufacturing (example ICP: replace with yours)

buyer_role.instructions: What role does this person most likely play in a buying decision, based on job_title?

criteria.vendor_or_spam: Selling something to us, or not a real inquiry
criteria.student_or_job_seeker: Student, researcher, or looking for a job
criteria.practitioner: Hands-on user of the product, individual contributor
criteria.influencer: Manager or senior individual contributor who shapes the decision
criteria.decision_maker: Director, VP, C-level, or owner who signs off on purchases

sales_intent.instructions: The message asks for a demo, pricing, a trial, or a conversation with sales.
